title: Seven-Piece Tangram Gift Board
description: One original static seven-piece tangram gift set in a recessed square wooden tray. The editable pieces are the actual two large right-isosceles triangles, one medium triangle, two small triangles, one square and one parallelogram, arranged as the familiar complete square with narrow real clearance seams. The tray is one closed solid body with a true open recess and full floor, not four loose rails. Eight closed meshes and four opaque matte solid PBR roles. New complete tray and exact flat partition, not an extracted track segment, multi-cell storage cubby, texture decal or colour variant of a published puzzle board. Metres, Z up, front -Y, centred horizontal bounds and full tray base at Z0. Every piece has a real finite lower face resting on the tray floor. One whole prop, not seven separately counted assets. Static display only; no animation, drag interactions, puzzle-solver, manufacturing, safety or physical-stability claim.
